events.text: Battle of Hastings: William of Normandy defeats King Harold II.
A. A. Milne's Winnie-the-Pooh is published.
Chuck Yeager becomes the first pilot to fly faster than sound.
A U-2 spy plane photographs Soviet missile sites in Cuba.
Martin Luther King Jr. is awarded the Nobel Peace Prize.
Felix Baumgartner skydives from the stratosphere, breaking the sound barrier in free fall.

deaths.text: Leonard Bernstein, American composer and conductor
